issue: Chrome video button opened the old app without mediaStreams capability
cause: Both Desktop shortcut and Chrome native-host registration resolved to the old development Release directory; the verified newer product was built separately to preserve the then-running transfer. No new installation was present.
repair: Idle app closed gracefully; Downshift.exe, DownshiftNativeHost.exe and matching build-source.json replaced at existing launch path, with previous binaries backed up. Native-host registration, shortcut and data binding unchanged. Updated app relaunched and activated using native open.
limitations: Read-only normal bridge/capability and state preservation verification. No real streaming episode downloaded and no new site-support claim. Existing verified installer unchanged. No Git mutations.
